name: AlphaMissense
scope: Pathogenicity predictions for all possible human missense variants (hg38 file 642,961,469 bytes; hg19 622,293,310; isoform and amino-acid tables; gene-level averages).
mapping_methods: Precomputed per variant on Ensembl/UniProt isoforms.

licence.name: Conflicting statements, applied conservatively as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the copy held. The bucket README.pdf (2024-03-13) says all materials are licensed under CC BY 4.0; the header of the data file (2023) and the Zenodo record say CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the Ensembl VEP plugin page repeats CC BY and adds that use is subject to the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service.
licence.redistribution: Not redistributed here (data stay in git-ignored data/external/). Until the owner clarifies which statement governs the 2023 data files, redistribution would have to meet the stricter terms: attribution, non-commercial use, share-alike.

coverage_limitations: Prediction, not measurement. The class thresholds (0.34 and 0.564) were chosen for 90% precision on pathogenic and benign ClinVar variants, so ClinVar-based benchmarks of the classes are not independent of the calibration; the Ensembl VEP plugin page states that the model was not trained on ClinVar variants. The paper describing training and calibration was not readable here (bot challenge)

reuse_decision.rationale: Also embedded in dbNSFP, which needs registration; the open file lets us test predictor integration now. Both the gene-level table and the 643 MB variant table (71M canonical-transcript missense SNVs) are fetched, checksum-verified and structurally validated. Licence CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike), so the data stay in the git-ignored data/ area.

status.notes: GCS bucket metadata and MD5 verified.

unverified_fields: training and calibration details (paper not retrievable)
which licence statement governs the 2023 data files

evidence_profile.biological_context: Predicts a pathogenicity class for single amino-acid substitutions per transcript or isoform. No tissue, cell-type, dosage, inheritance or mechanism context is carried.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Computational prediction. Class thresholds were chosen to reach 90% precision on ClinVar labels although the model was not trained on ClinVar variants, so agreement with ClinVar is calibration and not independent confirmation. No per-variant uncertainty is provided.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Low. The score does not say whether a change causes loss or gain of function, destabilisation or a dominant-negative effect, and it cannot see effects that act through splicing or regulation.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: A pathogenicity likelihood for the substitution; no phenotype, penetrance or mode of inheritance.
evidence_profile.absence_means: No score exists for synonymous, nonsense, splice, indel, structural or non-coding variants. Absence of a prediction is not evidence of a benign effect.
